description: Search the Trisport.ro catalog (Romanian sports retailer: running, cycling, triathlon, swimming, outdoor, sports nutrition, GPS watches). Returns only products that can be bought now, with the current price in RON (VAT included), the old price when discounted, delivery estimate and product URL. IMPORTANT: the catalog is in Romanian — translate the customer's request into short Romanian keywords before searching (e.g. "bike helmet" → "casca bicicleta", "kids bike" → "bicicleta copii", "trail running shoes women" → "pantofi alergare trail dama"). Brand and model names work as they are (e.g. "Garmin Forerunner 265", "On Cloudmonster").

query.description: What the customer is looking for.

size.description: Optional size; keeps only products with that size in stock (e.g. "42", "M").
